verdict.rationale: Hoppscotch documents built-in AI features that suggest request names, generate structured payloads, and write pre-request scripts and test cases. These are AI-generated suggestions based on the user's request context, but nothing shows AI analysis that surfaces insights from response data or collections. The MCP server lets external agents act on workspace data, so it is not an in-product insight feature and is not credited here. Missing for 10: AI-generated insights or analysis of response and collection data, depth of documentation on the AI features, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
